title: Repair quotation
modifyPh: Lower labor, drop the roof sheets…
acceptedHint: Quotation accepted. Continue to the deposit page to confirm the construction order. This does not purchase materials.
pageDesc: Accept to lock the scope, then pay the 15% deposit on the checkout page. BuildMate holds it until the job is validly completed.
acceptBody: Accepting creates a construction order and a 15% deposit, then takes you straight to deposit checkout. BuildMate holds the money (mock). The 5% platform fee is 5% of the construction quote. You pay the remaining 85% directly to the contractor. Material-store quotes are not included. Cancelling after the deposit may forfeit it under the accepted terms, except where the contractor is at fault.
terms: I have read and agree to the deposit, cancellation, and 5% platform-fee terms.
laborHint: Enter construction labor costs only. Line total = quantity × labor unit price. Do not enter material prices.
mrlLaborHint: Enter the material list on this page. The customer picks a store and receives a separate material quote.
mrlNoPrice: Do not enter material prices or pick a store.
removeMaterialBody: The line will be removed from the list before the quotation is sent.
mrlInvalid: Each material line needs a name, a unit, and a quantity greater than 0.
mrlReadyBody: Store {store} already quoted. You can apply those prices to materials and transport.
mrlOverwriteConfirm: Current material lines will be replaced by the store quote. Continue?
totalMin: Quotation total must be greater than zero.
daysInvalid: Estimated days must be a whole number from 1 to 180.
